evidence.quote: shall disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated. ... Where the content forms part of an evidently artistic, creative, satirical, fictional or analogous work or programme,
evidence.locator: Art. 50(4); also 50(2) 'marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated'

outcomes.note: Art. 50(4) (secondary mirror of the Regulation) requires deployers to disclose artificially generated content that could pass as real, with a lighter duty for evidently artistic/fictional works; Art. 50(2) places machine-readable marking on providers (the generators). No platform/organiser rule fetched. Whether a stylised space game triggers any duty is a legal question left to the owner.
outcomes.would_settle: Official EUR-Lex text of Reg. 2024/1689 Art. 50 and its application date, plus the organiser's rules on AI disclosure.
